map.name: Russia
map.mapSpecificRules: The power plant market is restricted, and the rules for removing old plants are changed.

deckBuild.recharged: plants 6 and 14 are removed from the game. The market has 6 plants (3 current, 3 future) drawn at random from the low plants; the six undrawn low plants sit shuffled on top of the deck. Removal by player count (higher plants only): 2 players remove 6, 3 players remove 8, 4 players remove 4.
deckBuild.original: plants 6 and 14 are removed from the game; the market is 3, 4, 5 / 7, 8, 9. Plant 13 goes on top of the deck, then five shuffled cards (plants 10, 11 and the top three of the deck), then the rest, with the Step 3 card on the bottom.
